content: Kuate tuku Kiŋo nu o mbolŋge minit tukunu sine nu tuku pasa mayenu isgeŋ ta ake wamwamka li ndaka kurauka likube. Sine taŋa ndabe ta sine waŋ taŋaŋ kundu mayenu limba fare fare kumba ka ŋgisikamŋgig.
O buk Kuate nu eŋel kukulniŋgina le nane Moses tukul tunaig ta son saŋgri ŋak. Siŋgine mbuŋ kame pasa ta lukanaig ta lafunu kumumbi tinaig.

Sine siŋgine muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku pasa mayenu Suŋgoŋge te-mayokmba sakina le nane isnaig mbalŋge sine kubeu siŋginaig. Kile sine pasa mayenu te ake wamwamka likeg ta sine taŋamba ndo lafunu tamŋgig.
Kuate nu nuŋe pasa ta saŋgri pilemba wam yimyammbi nuŋe saŋgri kile-mayokka wam kitek ke likina. Nu nuŋe nzali dubimba Tukul Guwa tuku saŋgri yimyam niŋge likina.
Kilke kitek prowam tuku sakig ta kilke ta kulatkam tuku Kuate nu nuŋe eŋel madi ndaniŋgina.
Kuate tuku pasa mbolŋge ande nu teŋenmba kuyarna.

content.text: O Kuate, taŋgo nu ima le ne mara mara nu idus timba minit. Nu ima le ne nu turam tuku kulatkate.
Ne ait fagnu nu tumba eŋel kame kumnemŋge pilna.
Taŋana sulumba ne maŋ nu tumba te-mayokmba nyu suŋgo tuna.
Ne agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kilmba nu kumnemŋge patikina. Mune 8.4-6

content: Taŋamba Kuate nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kilmba taŋgo kumnemŋge patikina. Agaŋ ande taŋgoŋge kulat ndakanu taŋaŋ mine ndakate. Son. Kile ait te mbolŋge agaŋ ndende ŋakmba taŋgo kumnemŋge minig le sine kaŋger ndakeg.

Kaŋger ndakeg ta Yesus kaŋgermba nu mbolŋge kila pileg. Kuate nu taŋgo ake sinaŋ make patika Yesus nu ŋakmba tuku kumwa ŋga nu tumba ait fagnu eŋel kame kumnemŋge pilna. Pilna le nu ŋakmba tuku kumna sulumba nyu suŋgo pasa ŋak mayok kina.

Kuate nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-mayokkina. Ŋakmba nu tuku nzali ndo dubiwam tuku minig. Nu taŋgo gudommba nuŋe kiŋo kame mayok ka nuŋe kilŋa tugumŋge minam tuku idusna sulumba nu kumumbi nane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku taŋgo rar suŋgo tuna. Yesus nu rar ta mbolŋge nu sine tuku gabat mayok ka sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋgit.
Taŋgo nane Kuate tuku mbal mayok kambim tuku ande nu atrau piro biyit ta nane nu ndoŋ tugu ndindo. Ŋakmba Kuate tuku minig. Ta tuku siŋgine Suŋgo nu sine yabu ndaka yiŋe maib kame ŋga
sine ndoŋ minam tuku Mam nuŋe teŋenmba sana.

content.text: Mam Kuate, ye ne tuku nyu suŋgo ta yiŋe maib kame ndoŋ te-mayokmba saka minamŋgit.
Ye naŋe mbal ŋgamukŋge munembi ne tuku nyu te-duŋgamŋgit ŋgina. Mune 22.2

content: Nu maŋ kuyar ande mbolŋge teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Kuate, ye ne tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋget ŋgina. Aisaia 8.17
Ye yiŋe maib kame Kuateŋge ye sina ta ndoŋ minet ŋgina. Aisaia 8.18

content: Kuate nu Yesus tuna mbal nane ŋgarosu ŋak. Ta tuku Kristus nu sine taŋaŋ ŋgarosu ŋak mayok kina. Taŋamba nu maŋau ta dubimba nu kumna. Nu kumna ta tiŋga kume tuku saŋgri Satan te-ibeŋna sulumba
sine kumam tuku kuru-kuruka mineg ta sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋga kuru kuru wam ta tukulna.
Nu eŋel kame turkam tuku nde ndakina ta kilimok. Nu sine Abraham tuku tugu ŋakmba tursiŋgam tuku ndekina.

Ta tuku nu nuŋe maib kame minig taŋaŋ mayok kina. Wam ta mbolŋge ndo nu sine tuku pris suŋgo mayok kambim kumuŋ. Nu kumna sulumba nu Kuate tugumŋge sine mapeka sine tuku atrau piro kumumbi biyit le Kuate nu sine tuku une sauka gilaiŋgate.
Nu sine taŋgo taŋaŋ mayok kina le Satan nu tagomba minna ta nu piti ta kamusna tukunu kile nu sine tago mbolŋge mineg ta nu sine tursiŋgam kumuŋ.
